integrity: The universal statements are proved analytically in RESULT.md.
verify.py supplies bounded checks only and is not used as an infinite proof.
Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is for deterministic worst-case noise words whose adjacent symbols differ; no stochastic channel law or stochastic capacity is claimed.

The \(q\ge3\) singleton branch is implied by a general prior coupled-graph criterion once the difference-coverage lemma is proved; the finite-block binary extremizer classification and count are the specific refinement.
Searches are not an exhaustive proof of global novelty.
title: Finite-block zero-error codebooks for proper-colouring noise
